@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Interpersonal harmony is one of the most important e______ts of Chinese culture.
= elements
~詞義 element（n.）要素
~原文 Interpersonal harmony is one of the most important elements of Chinese culture.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government has a______ed that it will be making a series of changes to improve the economic situation.
= announced
~詞義 announce（v.）宣布
~原文 The government has announced that it will be making a series of changes to improve the economic situation.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government promised to take i______e action to help those who were most in need.
= immediate
~詞義 immediate（adj.）立刻的
~原文 The government promised to take immediate action to help those who were most in need.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was ______ (fortune) that the concert was canceled just minutes before it started due to the heavy rain.
= unfortunate
~詞義 unfortunate（adj.）不幸的
~原文 It was unfortunate that the concert was canceled just minutes before it started due to the heavy rain.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Sometimes people use computers to perform advanced calculations, as computers are both efficient and ______ (accuracy).
= accurate
~詞義 accurate（adj.）正確的;準確的
~原文 Sometimes people use computers to perform advanced calculations, as computers are both efficient and accurate.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Einstein was ______ the Nobel Prize for his outstanding contribution to modern physics.
A: awarded
B: confused
C: expanded
D: wandered
= A
~詞義 award（v.）頒發
~原文 Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his outstanding contribution to modern physics.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After the exam ended, the teacher walked down each row and ______ all the answer sheets.
A: healed
B: widened
C: collected
D: destroyed
= C
~詞義 collect（v.）收取
~原文 After the exam ended, the teacher walked down each row and collected all the answer sheets.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Nowadays, children are encouraged to be ______ rather than think like everyone else.
A: pessimistic
B: normal
C: dramatic
D: creative
= D
~詞義 creative（adj.）有創意的
~原文 Nowadays, children are encouraged to be creative rather than think like everyone else.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a strong ______ between smoking and lung cancer; people who smoke are a lot more likely to develop it.
A: kingdom
B: connection
C: fortune
D: journey
= B
~詞義 connection（n.）關聯;連結
~原文 There is a strong connection between smoking and lung cancer; people who smoke are a lot more likely to develop it.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Bread and butter is practically a daily ______ for most French people.
A: budget
B: creature
C: necessity
D: property
= C
~詞義 necessity（n.）必需品
~原文 Bread and butter is practically a daily necessity for most French people.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: creatures
B: connect
C: passion
D: march
E: destruction
F: fortune

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Most people hope that they can make a ______ someday.
= F
~詞義 fortune（n.）財富
~原文 Most people hope that they can make a fortune someday.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: A band will lead the victory parade and slowly ______ through the streets tomorrow morning.
= D
~詞義 march（v.）行進
~原文 A band will lead the victory parade and slowly march through the streets tomorrow morning.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: If you have great ______ for your job, you will surely be successful.
= C
~詞義 passion（n.）熱情
~原文 If you have great passion for your job, you will surely be successful.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Amazon rainforest is home to a great variety of ______.
= A
~詞義 creatures（n.）生物
~原文 The Amazon rainforest is home to a great variety of creatures.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ of the rainforest will result in more pollution and less rain in the world.
= E
~詞義 destruction（n.）破壞
~原文 The destruction of the rainforest will result in more pollution and less rain in the world.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: confuse
B: creation
C: optimistic
D: race
E: wander
F: racial

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: This is the best ______ that this artist has ever produced.
= B
~詞義 creation（n.）創作
~原文 This is the best creation that this artist has ever produced.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Martin trained for months, hoping to win the ______ and prove that hard work matters more than talent.
= D
~詞義 race（n.）比賽
~原文 Martin trained for months, hoping to win the race and prove that hard work matters more than talent.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ discrimination in this country is widespread and has caused a lot of violence and unrest.
= F
~詞義 racial（adj.）種族的
~原文 Racial discrimination in this country is widespread and has caused a lot of violence and unrest.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Joanna is ______ about her chances of winning the scholarship to study abroad.
= C
~詞義 optimistic（adj.）樂觀的
~原文 Joanna is optimistic about her chances of winning the scholarship to study abroad.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Some tourists ______ Taiwan with Thailand, even though the two countries have very different cultures and languages.
= A
~詞義 confuse（v.）混淆
~原文 Some tourists confuse Taiwan with Thailand, even though the two countries have very different cultures and languages.
